APPROVE
Extracting the `Apply` branch (its nested ternaries, early-exit `if`, and lambda ternaries) removes most of the 25 points, and dropping `var m = method;` is safe because C# `foreach` variables are captured per iteration; I couldn't verify the build because the source isn't on this machine, so it assumes the file already imports `System.Reflection` and that `appliers` really is a `Dictionary<Type, Func<object, object, object, object?>>`.
